method: Source phase summaries retained unchanged. Additional p95 uses nearest rank ceil(0.95*n). Cached timing headers are excluded from current application stages. Stage durations overlap and must not be added.
confounders: The first run overlapped static deployment transfer according to the run owner; interference size is not measured.
These are sequential observations, not controlled randomized worker on/off tests. Cache history and other client/server load can differ.
No pool-checkout, database execution-only, I/O-wait or packet-loss samples are available.
HTTP/2 independent TLS sessions test endpoints, not browser journeys. Connection setup is excluded from request timing.

runs.condition_evidence: Run owner supplied worker state; benchmark JSON does not independently attest worker status
runs.transport: HTTP/2 100 independent TLS sessions, one concurrent request per session, Windows PC public internet

measurement_contract.scope: API endpoint load; not the browser search/detail user flow

phases.warm: Three subsequent batches; not guaranteed cache hits
phases.after_1600ms: Batch after a 1600ms pause; classify expiry from response headers

measurement_contract.request_model: 100 independent TLS sessions; one offered concurrent request per session; sessions reused across phases and endpoints
measurement_contract.body_validation: ms/body_ms end at the readable end event; JSON/gzip validation runs only after the entire batch has received or failed
measurement_contract.stream_readiness: stream_ready_ms records Node stream readiness, not proven network-only or server queue time; peer_max_concurrent_streams is the observed peer limit
measurement_contract.timing: TTFB includes proxy/queue/transit; app_ms is current uncached application-header time. Do not subtract independent percentiles.
measurement_contract.origin_header: On edge HIT the origin cache header is historical, not a new origin lookup
measurement_contract.connection_setup: DNS/TCP/TLS/connect and peer-settings readiness recorded separately; all attempts settle before the first batch; no automatic reconnect
